context: A casual chat between a teen and her aunt about an embarrassing memory
purpose: Teach: なにか/ほんの/まさか/なかろ/そりゃ/ゆう/一種/一切

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ叔母さん、昔のアルバム見てたら、なにか変な写真出てきたんだけど。
lines.en: Hey auntie, I was looking at old albums and some weird photo turned up.
lines.style: Casual teen tone, slightly teasing, lifts into a curious question.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: えっ、まさかあの髪をゆうために必死だった七五三のやつ?あれはほんの子供の頃でしょ。
lines.en: Huh, surely not that shichi-go-san one where I struggled hard to do my hair up? That was just when I was little.
lines.style: Warm aunt voice, slightly flustered, rises in pitch on まさか.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 違う違う、高校の文化祭のやつ。叔母さんが舞台で転んで、一種の伝説になってる写真。
lines.en: No no, the high school culture festival one. The photo where you fell on stage and it became a kind of legend.
lines.style: Playful teen delivery, drops voice on the punchline with a giggle.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そりゃもう、思い出したくもないわよ。あんな恥ずかしいこと、そうそうあるもんじゃなかろうって今でも思う。
lines.en: Oh come on, I don't even want to remember that. I still think you don't run into embarrassment like that very often.
lines.style: Half-laughing groan, exaggerated suffering, drawn-out vowels for comedic effect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもお母さんが言うには、観客の大半が拍手してくれたんでしょ?
lines.en: But mom says most of the audience clapped for you, right?
lines.style: Encouraging teen tone, lifting at the end to coax a smile.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そう、拍手はね。でも先生の苦笑だけは一切忘れられない。穴があったら入りたかったわ。
lines.en: Yeah, the clapping yes. But I can never forget the teacher's wry smile. I wanted to crawl into a hole.
lines.style: Nostalgic, slower pace, soft self-deprecating chuckle at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわー、それは耐えられないかも。私だったら絶対学校行けない。
lines.en: Whoa, I couldn't handle that. I'd absolutely never go back to school.
lines.style: Sympathetic teen wince, drawn-out うわー with rising empathy.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: でしょ?でも今となっては、ほんのいい思い出。あんたも将来、笑える失敗いっぱい作りなさい。
lines.en: Right? But these days it's just a nice little memory. You should make lots of failures you can laugh at later too.
lines.style: Soft motherly warmth, slowing down, gentle smile audible in voice.
